Where you are able to record your mukbangs and ASMR in Roblox!

Features:
- Gluttony
- Camera controllers
- ASMR
- Chair adjustments
- Collab mukbang
- Cats 😺😺
- Apartments
- Many seating areas to blog!
- And many more upcoming ideas that'll come in my mind :)


This game is the perfect place if you can't eat the food you dream of which is why Mukbang Corner is here to make your cravings 100x more worse!
(or better...)

Expect bugs in this game as this game is under Testing or Beta

Thank you very munchers :) 💛💛

entries.descriptionOriginal:
⭐Please like/thumbs up and favorite for more updates!

Fight to become the ultimate legend.

Keybinds:
Q - Dash
Q (while ragdolled) - Evasive/Ragdoll Cancel
F - Block
G - Awaken
Left Click - Light Attack
B - Emote Wheel

This game's characters are all stickmen, original or from an anime.

You can play this game on any device.
